SELECT P.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, COALESCE(P.BID_PBANC_NO, P.BF_SPEC_RGST_NO, P.ORDER_PLAN_NO) AS pbancNo, P.PBANC_STEP_CD AS pbancStepCd, STEP.CD_NM AS pbancStepNm, P.PBANC_TYPE_CD AS pbancTypeCd, PTYP.CD_NM AS pbancTypeNm, P.PBANC_NM AS pbancNm, P.ORDER_INST_NM AS orderInstNm, P.ALTMNT_BGT_AMT AS altmntBgtAmt, P.BID_DDLN_DT AS bidDdlnDt, TEAM.TEAM_NM AS sprvsnTeamNm, ( SELECT LISTAGG(JT.TEAM_NM, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY JT.TEAM_NM) FROM TB_PTCP_TEAM PT JOIN TB_TEAM JT ON JT.TEAM_SN = PT.TEAM_SN WHERE PT.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN ) AS joinTeamNms, P.PBANC_STTS_CD AS pbancSttsCd, STTS.CD_NM AS pbancSttsNm, RTRN.CD_NM AS rtrnSeNm FROM TB_BID_PBANC P LEFT JOIN TB_TEAM TEAM ON TEAM.TEAM_SN = P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD STEP ON STEP.GROUP_CD = 'PBSTP' AND STEP.CD = P.PBANC_STEP_CD LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD PTYP ON PTYP.GROUP_CD = 'PBTYP' AND PTYP.CD = P.PBANC_TYPE_CD LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD STTS ON STTS.GROUP_CD = 'PBSTS' AND STTS.CD = P.PBANC_STTS_CD LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD RTRN ON RTRN.GROUP_CD = 'RTRSE' AND RTRN.CD = P.RTRN_SE_CD
ORDER BY P.REG_DT DESC, P.PBANC_SN DESC
ORDER BY P.BID_DDLN_DT ASC NULLS LAST, P.PBANC_SN ASC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT C.CD AS sttsCd, C.CD_NM AS sttsNm, NVL(N.CNT, 0) AS cnt FROM TB_COM_CD C LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PBANC_STTS_CD, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM TB_BID_PBANC GROUP BY PBANC_STTS_CD ) N ON N.PBANC_STTS_CD = C.CD WHERE C.GROUP_CD = 'PBSTS' AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY C.SORT_SEQ

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_BID_PBANC ( ORDER_PLAN_NO, BF_SPEC_RGST_NO, BID_PBANC_NO, BID_PBANC_CYCL, PBANC_STEP_CD, TRCK_STTS_CD, PBANC_TYPE_CD, PBANC_NM, ORDER_INST_NM, DMND_INST_NM, SW_BIZ_YN, ALTMNT_BGT_AMT, OPNN_DDLN_DT, BID_DDLN_DT, OPENG_DT, EVL_MTHD_NM, PBANC_DTL_URL, PBANC_STTS_CD, RGTR_ID, CLCT_DT, LAST_CFMTN_DT ) VALUES ( #{orderPlanNo}, #{bfSpecRgstNo}, #{bidPbancNo}, NVL(#{bidPbancCycl}, 0), #{pbancStepCd}, #{trckSttsCd}, #{pbancTypeCd}, #{pbancNm}, #{orderInstNm}, #{dmndInstNm}, #{swBizYn}, #{altmntBgtAmt}, #{opnnDdlnDt}, #{bidDdlnDt}, #{opengDt}, #{evlMthdNm}, #{pbancDtlUrl}, #{pbancSttsCd}, #{rgtrId}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT P.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, P.ORDER_PLAN_NO AS orderPlanNo, P.PBANC_NM AS pbancNm, P.ORDER_INST_NM AS orderInstNm, P.ALTMNT_BGT_AMT AS altmntBgtAmt FROM TB_BID_PBANC P WHERE P.PBANC_STEP_CD = #{stepCd} AND P.TRCK_STTS_CD = #{trckSttsCd} AND P.ORDER_PLAN_NO IS NOT NULL ORDER BY P.PBANC_SN
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BID_PBANC SET BF_SPEC_RGST_NO = #{bfSpecRgstNo}, PBANC_STEP_CD = #{toStepCd}, PBANC_NM = NVL(#{pbancNm}, PBANC_NM), DMND_INST_NM = NVL(#{dmndInstNm}, DMND_INST_NM), SW_BIZ_YN = NVL(#{swBizYn}, SW_BIZ_YN), ALTMNT_BGT_AMT = NVL(#{altmntBgtAmt}, ALTMNT_BGT_AMT), OPNN_DDLN_DT = NVL(#{opnnDdlnDt}, OPNN_DDLN_DT), CLCT_DT = SYSDATE, LAST_CFMTN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND PBANC_STEP_CD = #{fromStepCd} AND BF_SPEC_RGST_NO IS NULL
